shots.detail_en: CH holds the repaired pocket watch to his ear on the rooftop after rain, its second hand lagging half a beat behind the whole city.
shots.sub: 它比全世界慢一分钟。十年了——一分钟没多，也没少。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: FATHER places the pocket watch into BOY's palm on the same rooftop in 1993.
shots.sub: 表慢一点不亏——快一步抢到的，慢一步才看得见。
shots.speaker: FATHER

shots.detail_en: Back to the present, CH stares into the night as RED closes her umbrella and walks up behind him.
shots.sub: 又躲到这儿来。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: RED sits down at the low wall and takes a worn old photograph with whitened corners from her bag.
shots.sub: 整理旧物翻出来的——你看背面。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: The photograph: two young men laughing shoulder to shoulder in front of the old Lianhua hall, one holding a hand-drawn notebook, the other an account book.
The photo's back bears fountain-pen words 'Leave a bull market for the kids,' signed only with two surnames—Lu and Shen.
CH's fingertip strokes the photo, his throat tightening, while RED watches the city lights.
shots.sub: 我爹当年替你爸管账。九三年之后，他再没进过交易大厅一步。／所以他把你放在柜台——守一本干净的账。
shots.speaker: RED+CH

shots.detail_en: CH lays the photograph beside his father's notebook on the low wall as the night wind flips the page corner.
shots.sub: 爸——你看，我们没散。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: RED studies his profile, hesitates, and finally speaks.
shots.sub: 明天……熊天成要上电视了。
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: XIONG's smiling face fills a city-wide teaser montage—neon billboards, shopfront TVs and newspaper front pages.
shots.sub: 明晚，熊天成专访——十年了，我只想对港海说一句真话。
shots.speaker: TV

shots.detail_en: The crowd thickens before the lounge TV in the trading hall, whispers rippling like a tide.
shots.sub: 熊爷要开口了。／他说的，得听。
shots.speaker: CROWD

shots.detail_en: CH stares at the merciful smiling face on TV, a thin layer of ice forming in his eyes.
shots.sub: 十年前——他也是这么真诚。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: MANCANG sprints across the hall, the smile gone from his face for the first time.
shots.sub: 不好了！阿婆来了——她要拿养老钱，追那个涨得最凶的！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: At the counter an elderly woman fills out her order slip stroke by stroke, like copying scripture.
shots.sub: 小伙子们都能赢，我一个老太婆，赢点孙子的学费怎么了。
shots.speaker: GRANNY

shots.detail_en: MANCANG steps in front of the counter and gently presses his big hand on the slip—his flower shirt looks like armor for once.
shots.sub: 阿婆，全仓教主今天只教一条——养老钱，不上桌！
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: The old woman freezes as MANCANG lets his voice go soft and slow.
shots.sub: 赢了，孙子多一只鸡腿；输了，孙子陪您哭——这买卖，亏到姥姥家了。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: She folds the slip and tucks it back into her pocket, patting the back of MANCANG's hand.
shots.sub: 好孩子……你比我亲儿子还有样。
shots.speaker: GRANNY

shots.detail_en: CH and RED watch the scene from afar across the hall.
shots.sub: 满仓这个人——把心，全仓押在人身上了。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: In the closed hall MANCANG stands on a stool and pastes a hand-written poster onto the pillar.
shots.sub: 梭哈十诫，第一诫：养老钱，不上桌。
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: CH raises the pocket watch toward the city lights as the slow second hand creeps half a tick.
shots.sub: 爸，市场永远快我一步——所以我留一分钟，给不该忘的事。
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: The TV teaser flashes XIONG's face one last time, prayer beads turning on his wrist.
shots.sub: 十年了，港海需要一句真话。
shots.speaker: TV

shots.detail_en: Black end card with next-episode caption.
shots.sub: 他要说的那句'真话'——十年前，就有人听过全部的台词。
shots.speaker: VO
shots.card: 他要说的那句'真话'——十年前，就有人听过全部的台词。
